name: lab-table-oldest-first
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
Cholesterol, Total   220   01/02/2025
Cholesterol, Total   197   08/13/2026
HDL 45
note: Epic's SmartLinks print most-recent-first, but a Results Review grid can be sorted oldest-first. Taking 'the first row' there returns a stale value, so a dated row set is resolved by date.

name: lab-table-newest-first
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
Cholesterol, Total   197   08/13/2026
Cholesterol, Total   220   01/02/2025
HDL 45
note: The usual order still gives the same answer.

name: bp-list-oldest-first
note: An ascending BP reading list: the 2026 reading is current, not the 2025 one.

name: bmi-list-oldest-first
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
BMI Readings:
01/02/25 : 33.0 kg/m2
08/13/26 : 27.4 kg/m2
note: An ascending BMI list. 33.0 and 27.4 give materially different risks, so picking the stale one is not cosmetic.

name: bmi-list-newest-first
text:
Age: 74
Sex: male
BMI: BMI Readings from Last 3 Encounters:
09/10/26 : 21.35 kg/m2
06/23/26 : 26.00 kg/m2
note: The real @LASTBMI(3)@ order.

name: date-year-is-not-a-bmi
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
BMI Readings:
08/13/26 : 27.4 kg/m2
note: The two-digit year 26 is a plausible BMI, and the kg/m2 later on the line would otherwise vouch for it. A number that is one component of a date is never a measurement.

name: undated-readings-keep-first
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
BP:
  Today 142/88
  Last month 130/80
note: With no dates to compare, the most-recent-first convention stands.

name: same-date-twice-keeps-first
text:

Sex: M

note: Two rows from one draw: no basis to prefer the second.

name: two-digit-and-four-digit-years-compare
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M

name: at-goal-then-real-readings
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
A/P:
1. HTN: at goal. BP 128/78, BMI 27.4
note: 'At goal' describes a state the patient has REACHED, so the readings after it are real. Suppressing them would blank a very common plan format.

name: goal-then-actual-same-line
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
BP goal <130. Today BP 142/88
note: The target masking stops at the end of its sentence, so the reading that follows still parses.

name: ldl-goal-then-todays-ldl
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
LDL goal <70. LDL today 118
note: Same for a lipid plan written on one line.

name: a1c-at-target-then-value
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
A1c at target. A1c 6.4
note: 'At target' is the achieved-state phrasing.

name: goal-alone-still-suppressed
text:
Age: 58
Sex: M
A/P:
1. HLD: LDL goal < 70
note: A target with no accompanying measurement still yields nothing.

name: two-patients-pasted-together
text:

Sex: Male
BMI: 27.4
Total chol: 198
---

note: If two records are pasted together the fields must at least come from ONE of them consistently, never a mix of both.
